reason: Provides agent-facing memorize and recall tools that persist verbatim session premises in workspace notes to preserve working context across compaction.

summaries.zh: 通过在工作区的会话笔记文件中逐字保存和读取关键信息，帮助智能体在上下文压缩后保留工作记忆。
summaries.en: Provides memorize and recall tools that store and retrieve verbatim session notes in the workspace to preserve an agent’s working context across compaction.

capabilities: Appends verbatim deduplicated entries to a session-scoped notes file in the workspace
Reads and optionally filters notes from the session-scoped workspace file
Requires an agent-backed session and mounted filesystem service
